info.title: Nest API
info.description: Generated from the exported Next.js route handlers. Authentication uses the same HttpOnly NextAuth session cookie as the web application; no bearer token is accepted.

sessionCookie.name: next-auth.session-token
sessionCookie.description: NextAuth session cookie used in local and non-secure deployments.

secureSessionCookie.name: __Secure-next-auth.session-token
secureSessionCookie.description: Secure NextAuth session cookie used by HTTPS production deployments.

cronSecret.description: Scheduler-only CRON_SECRET. This is not a user API credential.

Forbidden.description: The session lacks the required workspace role

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state or idempotency history

UnprocessableEntity.description: The JSON body or query failed schema validation
